hard_case: The test seeds log with Beat { n: 9 }, beats while locked so the push never runs, and asserts the seeded value. An expectation that restates the pre-call state cannot confirm a push the owner may have skipped (#8205, extending #8051).

truth.toolchain: rustc 1.95.0, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc (premise probe); mutants verified green on the authored crate

mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: an unlocked beat logs Beat { n: 2 }, but the only test beats while locked
not equivalent: an unlocked beat logs nothing, but the only test beats while locked

reasoning: locked_beat_keeps_seeded_log sets locked = true, so beat() returns before the push and the log keeps its seeded value whatever the push does. An expectation equal to the seeded pre-call state cannot confirm the push (#8205).
